## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND signals lower fear while HYG (1W: -0.18% | 1M: +0.17%) / LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.41%) show credit stress ↑ rising and mixed trends — two independent confirmations of a neutral, conflicted tape.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -12.41%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress edging up: HYG/LQD ratio ↑ rising (HYG CORRECTION | LQD BELOW TREND), and Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) RECOVERY (SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION) is flat-to-mixed.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-cautious: SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND with TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION — stocks and duration both showing short-term nuance while yield-curve metrics remain largely flat.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND and Utilities holding up: XLU (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND; Tech XLK (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND but Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow breadth.

5. US vs Global?  
US stable: SPY (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) ABOVE TREND while EM strength is notable: EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%) RECOVERY.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Elevated: IBIT (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%) ABOVE TREND show speculative flows, while small caps IWM (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY — appetite present but selective.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Broad commodity bid: BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -1.99%) RECOVERY while gold GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy rally intact: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND with natural gas UNG (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND — cyclical commodity strength driving sector flows.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: XLE (1W/+1M positive) ABOVE TREND and EMs (EEM ABOVE TREND) showing consistent strength. Minor divergence: XLF (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -0.22%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%) CORRECTION show 1W/1M mismatches — monitor momentum for potential broadening or pullback.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to energy and EM risk via XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND and EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to cyclicals showing weakness such as XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND and XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, and monitor credit via HYG/LQD.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ABOVE TREND, EEM (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLY (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) BELOW TREND, XLI (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: WEAT (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) CORRECTION — volatile pullbacks possible; GLD (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) CORRECTION for tactical profit-taking.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency gauge), HYG/LQD ~0.75 (credit stress pivot), SPY/TLT ~9.37 (risk vs duration), XLK/XLF ~3.22 (tech vs financials tilt).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, with VXX falling but credit spreads edging wider — mixed confirmations. Energy and EM showing relative strength (XLE, EEM) while XLY/XLI weakness and XLF/TLT 1W/1M divergences are key risks to monitor.
